name: Airgetlám
text: Airgetlám means silver hand in Irish. The name is an agnomen given to the god Nuada. MacKillop gives Argetlám as a second spelling of the byname. Nuadu earned the title from his silver hand. Readers should see the Nuada entry for the full story.

attributes.attribute: name carried by the god Nuada

okr.objective: Record Airgetlám as the silver hand byname of Nuada.
key_results: Identify Nuada as the bearer of the byname.
Note Argetlám as an alternate spelling.
